## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo test --workspace` passes
- [ ] `cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings` is clean
- [ ] `cargo fmt --all -- --check` is clean
- [ ] New public items carry a `///` doc comment citing a primary source
- [ ] Tests added, and each one was **watched to fail** against the defect it targets

## If this changes a computed value

- [ ] The magnitude is stated above, measured rather than estimated
- [ ] Any pinned fixture or digest it moves has been regenerated, and the movement explained
- [ ] Published figures that quote the old value have been updated
